build_graph_attention_block: build a GraphAttentionBlock module with neighborhood attention, edge FFN, node attention, and node FFN for molecular graph processing
create_feedforward_network: create a FeedForwardNetwork module with normalization, activation, dropout, and optional residual scaling for graph neural networks
run_graph_attention_forward: run the GraphAttentionBlock forward pass on GraphAttentionData and neighbor representations to compute updated node and edge embeddings
review_neighborhood_attention_integratio: review how GraphAttentionBlock integrates NeighborhoodAttention and NodeAttention modules with configurable use_node_path flag
test_feedforward_residual_scaling: test the FeedForwardNetwork residual scaling mechanism that scales by inverse layer count when use_residual_scaling is enabled
